text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE FIRED - region=us-east1, az=az3, service=inference-runtime - High error rate (5xx) and kv-cache evictions. PagerDuty incident id pd_789123.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered 'inference-runtime - region us-east1 az3 - high 5xx rate' -> alerting carla_oncall (priority P1).

carla_oncall: Acked. Joining bridge in 2m. I see spike on Grafana: 5xxs to 30% for az3 nodes, latency +200ms.

alice_sre: I'm on it. Checking host-level metrics and NIC errors. Preliminary: NIC error counters jump ~11:02 UTC, some pod restarts from kubelet OOMs.

bob_runtime: Noted. Could be a kernel-level NIC interrupt storm; routing fallback may help. If we flip routing to prefer az1/az2 it should shed traffic quickly.

dan_support: Support queue getting increased error reports from a few enterprise tenants on us-east1. Sending customer-facing note after we confirm mitigation.

alice_sre: Running quick diff on autoscaler logs and shard placement. Kube node list shows 6 nodes in az3 in NotReady. Probable flapping NIC.

carla_oncall: Activate automated fallback for region us-east1 -> prefer variants in az1/az2. @bob_runtime can you run the routing toggle?

bob_runtime: Doing it now.

bob_runtime: ```
# toggle routing fallback
rbctl routing set-fallback --region us-east1 --enable true --reason "az3 nic flap + high 5xx" --ttl 600
```

bob_runtime: Done. Push routed traffic off az3 over next 30s. Watchers: please monitor percent routed to az3 in the traffic dashboard.

alice_sre: KV-cache evictions dropping after routing change, 5xxs falling to 6% in 2m. Node NotReady count still 6 but new connections are avoiding az3.

incident-bot: NOTE: fallback policy applied by bob_runtime (id=rbf-20260314-001). Autoscaling adjustments suspended for 10m per policy.

carla_oncall: Good. Start draining remaining pods in az3 to speed remediations. Use cordon/drain with grace 30s. @alice_sre please coordinate.

alice_sre: ```
kubectl cordon node-az3-14
kubectl drain node-az3-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

alice_sre: Drains ongoing. Replacements getting scheduled in az1/az2 as expected.

dan_support: Drafting customer note: "We are aware of increased errors for a subset of requests routed through us-east1 az3. Traffic has been redirected and we're monitoring. ETA for full recovery: 30-60m." Anyone object?

emily_prod: Send it. Add an ops contact and link to bridge. Keep wording non-technical.

carla_oncall: PagerDuty: escalate to SRE lead if not resolved in 15m. @alice_sre please check NIC vendor logs on faulty nodes, may need host reboot or NIC firmware patch.

alice_sre: Checking BMC and dmesg now. Seeing repeated kernel i40e warnings referencing 'resetting link' with timestamp clusters at 11:02 and 11:07. I'll request host reboot on the two most noisy hosts.

bob_runtime: I've also temporarily increased the capacity in Dedicated pool for us-east1 (reserve extra shards) to reduce tail latency while routing moves. Command: ```rbctl capacity add --pool dedicated-us-east1 --count 4 --reason "mitigate az3 fallout"```

bob_runtime: Capacity add succeeded. Monitoring CPU/GPU utilization, tail latency normalizing.

incident-bot: pagerduty: pd_789123 -> acknowledged by carla_oncall at 1767990155. Escalation timer set (15m).

carla_oncall: Reboots scheduled: node-az3-11 and node-az3-14. Ops will reboot now. Expect node rejoin ~5-7m after grub.

alice_sre: Reboots done. Nodes rejoined, NIC warnings reduced. Evictions stopped. Running full healthcheck suite.

bob_runtime: Rebalance finished, kv-cache warmups completed. 5xxs back to baseline 0.8% across region. Routing fallback still active for TTL window; we can consider re-enabling az3 once stable for 10m.

carla_oncall: Confirming customer impact: Affected traffic ~4% of total, mostly low-volume enterprise tenants hitting long-context workloads. No data loss. Logged all customer IDs for follow-up. @dan_support add to RCA communication.

dan_support: Logged tenants, will follow up with templated email and offer rate-limited replays if they saw degraded responses.

incident-bot: ACTION: create incident ticket INC-20260314-az3-nic-flap (auto-created). Bridge: https://zoombridge.example/incident-INC-20260314

emily_prod: Good work. After 30m of stability we should rollback the routing fallback and mark as resolved. Assign postmortem to alice_sre and bob_runtime.

carla_oncall: Agree. I'll wait 32m then remove fallback if metrics hold. Handing off to bob_runtime for 1h oncall coverage. Thanks team.

bob_runtime: Taking handoff. Monitoring for 1h. If any recurrence, escalate to network infra.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: fallback policy will be removed at 1767992345 unless new alerts fire. Post-incident tasks: postmortem, host firmware check, update automated remediation runbook.

carla_oncall: Closing PD incident after handoff. pd_789123 -> status resolved by carla_oncall.

bob_runtime: Removing fallback now per plan. ```
rbctl routing set-fallback --region us-east1 --enable false --reason "stability confirmed"
```

bob_runtime: Fallback removed. Traffic to az3 resumed gradually, healthchecks green.

alice_sre: Final checks pass. Scheduling postmortem draft and firmware update tickets.

dan_support: Customer note sent. No escalations.

emily_prod: Thanks all. Postmortem owners: alice_sre, bob_runtime. Add timelines and mitigations. :thumbsup:

carla_oncall: End of thread. Great coordination.
